description: Alberta Flood Hazard Identification Program Mapping is a dataset listed in Alberta open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Parks. Flood studies include detailed engineering reports and flood maps. The engineering reports are typically technical in nature and document the data, assumptions, and results of the hydrologic and hydraulic analyses required to create flood maps. Flood maps are created by combining hydraulic model results for different sized floods with high-accuracy ground information. Coverage: Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Parks. Its tags are -CANADA, ALBERTA, ENVIRONMENT, FLOOD-HAZARD-IDENTIFICATION-PROGRAM, FLOOD-MAPS. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-alberta-portal.
